title: COSMOS Test Suite v0.1.0: a platform for attempting to falsify cosmological hypotheses
notes: No scientific findings are claimed. None of the 35 registered research questions has been answered, and the one implemented experiment (EXP-001) has only ever consumed synthetic data. Please cite this deposit as a platform, not as a result. One external validation was performed, of BAO distance measures against real DESI DR2 vectors (arXiv:2503.14738, arXiv:2503.14739); it found an error in this codebase and an unresolved labelling problem in a third-party data mirror.
